    Research interest Contact

    Ritika Aggarwal     		I am interested in how the intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) of E3 ubiquitin ligases recognize and recruit their substrates. I focus on HUWE1, a large HECT-type E3 ligase known for its unusually broad substrate range. I want to understand the molecular mechanisms that let HUWE1 bind so many different substrates, using all-atom and coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations together with machine learning. aggarwar@uni-mainz.de
